app.name: Rail Builder
app.description: Find out which wooden train layouts you can build right now with the pieces you already own.

home.title: What can you build with your wooden track?
home.subtitle: Tell us which pieces are in your box: the app shows the layouts you can build right now and guides your child step by step.
home.step1Text: Add your sets in one tap, then adjust piece by piece.
home.step2Text: See the layouts you can build with what you have, and the ones missing just one to three pieces.
home.step3Text: Your child follows the plan step by step, with big buttons and instructions read aloud.
home.demoText: {curves} curves and {straights} straights. The engine checks every joint and makes sure the loop closes.

pieces.title: Piece catalogue
pieces.intro: Each piece is described by its shape and its ends (male or female): that is how we can check that a layout closes.
pieces.setsIntro: Adding a set puts all of its pieces in your box at once.
